heading: OCR engine × layout model comparison in docling-serve
method: Setup: every configuration runs in docling-serve v1.35.0 on the same RTX 4090 with the same options (table_mode accurate, ocr_lang de, pdf_backend docling_parse, markdown with image placeholders, a page-break placeholder to split pages). Only the OCR engine and the layout model change. RapidOCR runs on onnxruntime GPU with the shape patch active; GLM-OCR is the zai-org/GLM-OCR vision-language model served by vLLM 0.29 and called per region.

Plugin versions: “fixed” is docling-pp-doc-layout 0.2.4, which returns the raw layout clusters so docling post-processes them after OCR. The released 0.2.3 dropped every layout region without PDF text before OCR ran, so scanned pages and photos came out empty with region-based OCR.

Timing: server-side conversion time reported by docling-serve (processing_time), models already loaded; wall time (upload to result download) where the server did not report it. For GLM-OCR this includes the calls to the vLLM server.

Synthetic documents: generated with exact ground truth. Body F1 compares the words of the output with the ground-truth markdown; Headings, Tables, Order and Noise as in the converter comparison. The text-source table tags every snippet by how it is stored in the PDF (real text, vector outlines, embedded image, scan).
Real documents: compared with the PDF's own text layer (pypdfium2) on pages that have one. Recall below 1 means missing text, precision below 1 means extra words (OCR of images, noise, duplicates).
Reference transcriptions: the handwritten note (ocr.png) and the phone photo (PXL_…jpg) have no text layer; they are scored against hand-made transcriptions in references.json.

Empty pages: a page has text when its text layer has at least 20 words or when any configuration read at least 20 words from it (scans, photos). It counts as empty for a configuration that returned fewer than 5 words for it. The released plugin leaves empty pages out of the markdown altogether, so its page split is shorter than the document; those outputs are aligned to the pages by word overlap with the text layer and the other configurations.

Words not in the reference: output words that appear nowhere in the ground truth (synthetic documents) or the reference transcription. Words with a close match in the reference (similarity ≥ 0.7) are likely misreadings; the others are text the engine made up or read from elsewhere on the page.
title: OCR Engine × Layout Comparison
